Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — I finished a systemic-failure signal scan for Jan–Mar. Pulled recurring signatures across postmortems and alerts. Top 3 noisy drivers: 1) KV cache eviction hotspots (esp. multi-tenant LRU thrash), 2) model-fallback oscillations when Dedicated pools degrade, 3) gRPC connection churn on older GPU nodes. Full report: https://redwood-internal/reports/sys-scan-q1-2026

Zach Patel: awesome, can you paste the top 5 signatures + % of incidents here so we can match to SLAs?

Maria Chen: sure — quick snapshot from the query I ran:

```
signature | pct_incidents
KV_CACHE_EVICT_HOTSPOT | 28%
MODEL_FALLBACK_OSCILLATION | 19%
GRPC_CONN_CHURN_NODE_OLD | 14%
AUTOSCALER_SUDDEN_DROP | 9%
TOKENIZER_MODEL_OOM | 7%
```

Query used:
```
SELECT signature, count(*)*100.0/(SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE detected_at >= '2026-01-01') as pct_incidents
FROM incidents
WHERE detected_at >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY signature
ORDER BY pct_incidents DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

Devon Li: I can own KV cache eviction. Plan: (1) increase per-tenant cap on hot paths, (2) add adaptive TTLs, (3) instrument eviction latency metrics. ETA 3 weeks.

Anna Gómez: for the model-fallback oscillation, we should confirm whether rollouts + autoscaler interplay is the root cause. I can take that one if okay. I expect 2 sprints to dig + canary a fix.

Maria Chen: @Devon Li and @Anna Gómez — great. Can you add short PRDs to the incident board with milestones? I'll create the epic in Jira and link.

incidents-bot: Created epic INC-4321: "Systemic signal remediation Q1-2026" and added labels: recurrence-scan, priority-high. https://jira.local/browse/INC-4321

Zach Patel: quick Q on timelines — does the KV change risk any regression for Dedicated latency? Need a rollback plan.

Devon Li: good call. Rollback plan: revert cache-size env + feature flag. Test plan: load test with 2x peak qps, check p95 and cache hit ratio. I'll add the feature-flag toggle in the PR.

Anna Gómez: for the fallback oscillation I'll add an automated canary rule to the console: if fallback rate > 5% for 5m hold rollouts and alert PS. Also adding an eval prompt set to detect semantic regressions during canary.

Maria Chen: action items (add these to INC-4321):
- Devon Li — KV eviction fixes + e2e load test + rollback docs — due 2026-04-15
- Anna Gómez — Model-fallback root-cause probe + canary gating + eval set — due 2026-04-22
- Zach Patel — Coordinate with eng-releases on timing and SLA comms — due 2026-04-10
- Maria Chen — Obs dashboards and alert refinements for signatures, and weekly pulse check — todo by 2026-04-08

Zach Patel: noted. I'll sync with releases today and drop a calendar invite.

Devon Li: added — creating PR skeleton now and will upload load test results to the epic.

Anna Gómez: adding canary rules and evals to the console board, will ping when ready for review.

Maria Chen: thanks all. Let's meet for a 30m sync next Wed 10am PT to triage blockers. If anyone needs earlier, ping here. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Sync: Systemic signal remediation" on 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC.
